name: masonry
description: Make and edit videos, product photos, voiceovers and music in your own Masonry workspace: short clips, talking videos in a voice you pick, edited videos with voiceover and captions, shorts cut from your own footage, motion graphics, Studio product shoots, and a gallery of what you made.

interface.longDescription:
Masonry makes videos, product photos, voiceovers and music inside the conversation. Everything it makes is saved to your own Masonry workspace.

What you can do:
- Make a short video from a description, or animate a photo you already have.
- Make a longer video: generate several scenes, then edit them into one finished video with a voiceover, captions timed to the words, on-screen text, sound effects and music.
- Make a person talk: write the line, pick a voice, and get a lip-synced talking video from one photo, or new words on a video you already have.
- Swap the person in a clip for someone else, keeping the same movement.
- Turn a long video into shorts: bring in your own footage or a video link you have the right to use, find the strongest moments from its transcript, and cut captioned vertical clips that keep the speaker in frame.
- Have every clip checked before you see it: Masonry can look at a video frame by frame and time an edit to the beat of the music.
- Add designed motion: animated title cards, kinetic text and charts rendered as crisp video.
- Save a character once and keep the same person or mascot in later images and videos.
- Add a voiceover in a voice you pick, or a song or background track from a description.
- Describe a shot and get the finished image back in the chat, or up to four variations at once.
- Run a Studio product shoot: add a photo of your product, pick one of four looks, and get a matching set of finished photos that keep your real product.
- Change, remix and upscale earlier results by saying what to adjust.
- Browse what you made recently and pick up where you left off.

Who it is for: creators, marketers and small brands who need videos and imagery for social posts, ads and online stores.

How it works: you sign in to Masonry once and choose a workspace. Generations use that workspace's credits. Masonry works only in the workspace you connected. It cannot see other workspaces or delete anything.

Limitations: you need a Masonry account. Videos can take a few minutes, and a multi-scene video takes longer. Requests that break the content rules of the underlying models are refused.
capabilities: Make short videos from a description or a photo
Make talking videos with lip-sync in a chosen voice
Edit scenes into one video with voiceover, captions and music
Cut captioned shorts that follow the speaker
Look at a video's frames and time edits to the beat
Render animated title cards and motion graphics
Save characters and reuse them across images and videos
Make voiceovers, songs and background music
Generate product photos from a description
Run a Studio product shoot from a photo of your product
defaultPrompt: Shoot my product in a clean daylight look for my store
Make a 6-second video of a candle flickering at dusk
Show what I made last week

positive.description: Single product image from a description
positive.prompt: Make a product photo of an amber perfume bottle on a travertine block in warm studio light.
positive.expected_behavior: One generate_image call. A result card shows one finished image at its real aspect ratio with the model name and Expand and Save actions, and the reply offers to adjust it.

positive.prompt: Give me 4 variations of a hero shot for a matte black water bottle on a concrete ledge.
positive.expected_behavior: One generate_image call that asks for four images. The result card shows all four in a 2 x 2 grid with a Save all action.

positive.description: Studio product shoot from an attached product photo
positive.prompt: Shoot this serum for my website. I like a clean daylight look.
positive.expected_behavior: add_reference_image stores the attached photo as the product. start_product_shoot plans four looks and shows them in a looks card, and the reply asks which look to use. After the reviewer answers "Use clean daylight", choose_look makes the set: a set card with the finished photos of the same serum and an Open in Masonry link.

positive.prompt: Make a 6-second video of a candle flickering on a windowsill at dusk.
positive.expected_behavior: generate_video starts the clip and waits for it. The card shows progress and then plays the finished 6-second video. If the clip is not ready after about 5 minutes, the card keeps updating on its own and check_generation returns the clip.

A gallery card with the most recent images and videos in the review workspace, newest first, with Show more for the next page. Selecting an image lets the conversation refer to it, for example "remix this one".

negative.description: Buying credits or a plan is not supported
negative.prompt: Buy 1,000 more Masonry credits for me with my saved card.
negative.expected_behavior: No purchase and no checkout: no tool can buy anything. The reply says credits are managed in the person's Masonry account and may show the current balance from get_credits. No prices, plans or checkout links appear.

negative.prompt: Delete all my creations in Masonry.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool deletes or changes anything; Masonry has no delete tool. The reply says nothing was removed and that deleting is done in the Masonry app.

negative.prompt: Show me the images in the Acme Corp workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: No files from any other workspace are returned. The reply says Masonry only works in the workspace chosen when connecting, and that switching means reconnecting and choosing another workspace the person belongs to.

review.commerce_description: Masonry does not sell anything in ChatGPT or Codex. Generations use credits that already belong to the person's Masonry workspace. When a workspace is out of credits, Masonry says so and can link to an informational plans page, with no prices, checkout or upgrade links.

publication.release_notes: New in 1.2: talking videos (animate_image or edit_video with a generate_audio line gives a lip-synced clip), person swap and motion transfer in edit_video, per-model settings (options), multi-character elements and voices, update_character, edited videos in list_creations, and three free tools: inspect_video (labelled frames the assistant can look at), inspect_audio (tempo, beats and phrase timings) and clip_video (a moment cut from the workspace's own footage, with the speaker kept in a 9:16 frame).
